name: Invoice note
words: Overnight: add invoice notes to tally (the plan below).
goal: Invoices can carry a free-text note that is saved, printed and documented.
rules: Work only in this repository. Don't push. Every "done when" needs its own evidence.

phases.name: Invoice note
phases.scope: Add an optional note to invoices. `buildInvoice` takes an optional `note` in its options and keeps it on the invoice; `renderInvoiceText` prints it as the invoice's last line, `Note: <text>`, and an invoice without a note is built and printed exactly as before. `node src/cli.ts invoice` takes `--note <text>` and saves the note with the invoice. Show the option in the README's Usage.
doneWhen: An invoice built with a note renders `Note: <text>` as its last line, and one without a note renders exactly as before; a test in test/invoice.test.ts covers both.
`node src/cli.ts invoice ... --note "Paid by card"` prints the note as the invoice's last line and saves it on the invoice in the data file.
The README's Usage shows an invoice command with `--note`.
